_about: Hero voice lines, keyed by the character's PrimaryClass. A character is a pairing (PrimaryClass/SecondaryClass) and NEUTRAL is not pairable, so there are exactly 8 voices. Stems follow vo_<class>_<moment>_<n> and resolve as sfx/<stem>, the same Addressables address the card sound player already uses.

_moments.match_start: No MatchStarted event exists in GameEventKind. The first TurnStarted is the only stand-in.
_moments.turn_start: RULING (Sam, 2026-08-28): play at a LOW RATE -- occasionally, not every turn. So three variants is enough and the set does not need widening. The line is a flourish, not a turn marker; the turn clock already marks the turn.
_moments.rope: Server fires at ServerOptions.RopeMs = 15_000, i.e. 15s before the deadline. TurnClockView already reacts to it by tinting the number red.
_moments.win: MatchOutcome.Player0Win / Player1Win, resolved against the local seat.
_moments.lose: Same event, opposite seat. MatchOutcome.Draw has no line and falls through silent.
_moments.draw: MatchOutcome.Draw. Played by PlayMatchEndLine on the same beat as win/lose (Sam, 2026-10-20: was silent). Lines reviewed 2026-10-20; a class may have one or two.
_moments.fatigue: FatigueDamage on the LOCAL hero (drawing from an empty deck). Can fire several turns running, hence two lines where Sam kept two.
_moments.burn: CardDrawn with the Overdraw flag on a LOCAL card: drawn into a full hand and burned. The owner is resolved from the local graveyard, since the event names only the card.
_moments.spark: CardPlayed of the LOCAL player's Spark (MatchOpeningDeal.SparkCardId). At most once per match.
_moments.vs_<class>: Versus-screen banter, one line per opposing class (Sam picked whimsy-pass #3, 2026-10-17). Each pair of heroes plays as a fixed exchange: the hero in _versus_openers speaks first and the other answers, whichever seat is local, because the reply only lands after its opener. A mirror is one line, spoken by both. Only the primary class speaks, so the hidden secondary stays hidden.

_delivery: No shouted or high-energy voices on the account, so lines are written for CONTROLLED delivery -- certainty and menace rather than volume. MEASURED 2026-08-28: every voice on the account accepts model_id eleven_v3 and its inline audio tags ([shouts], [whispers], emotion tags), even though the voice list's high_quality_base_model_ids field never enumerates v3 -- that field is not evidence of incompatibility. Older TTS models ignore the tags and read the brackets aloud, so the model id has to be eleven_v3 wherever a tag is used. HETERONYMS ARE RESPELLED, NOT REWRITTEN (Sam, 2026-08-28): eleven_v3 read CLOCKWRIGHT's 'Wound, set, and ready.' as the INJURY (/wuwnd/) rather than the wound spring (/wownd/), and no audio tag fixes a word the model has already disambiguated wrong. The line in this file is therefore spelled 'Wownd' -- the phonetic respelling is the INPUT, and the listener still hears the authored line. If a line here looks misspelled, it is a pronunciation fix; check the audio before correcting the spelling.
_casting: Cast by auditioning candidates on the CLASS'S OWN LINES, not on the library demo reel (Sam, 2026-08-28): Priyanka demoed well and lost on the actual lines. A demo is chosen to flatter the voice; five words of 'Even the sea recedes' is not. Audition before committing 15 lines to a voice -- it costs ~30 credits.
_models: MEASURED 2026-10-18 with a real one-word call per voice: all eight voices accept BOTH eleven_v3 and eleven_v4 (eleven_v4 and eleven_v4_turbo are now on the account's model list). high_quality_base_model_ids still lists neither for any voice, so it remains no evidence either way. The versus batch was generated on eleven_v3, the dispatcher's model, like every clip before it.
